sources.sourceTitle: USGS Water Science School - The Water Cycle
NASA Earth Observatory - The Water Cycle

facts.statement: Heat from the Sun causes liquid water at Earth's surface to evaporate into water vapor.
Water vapor cools in the atmosphere and condenses into tiny droplets that form clouds.
When cloud droplets grow heavy enough, water falls back to Earth as precipitation such as rain or snow.
Water collects in rivers, lakes, oceans, soil, ice, and groundwater before cycling again.
